scorecard.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
scorecard.coaching: While agent acknowledged the initial distress, she completely ignored the customer's severe emotional breakdown at [08:15] when faced with a 5-day medical isolation delay.

grader.scenario: Landline number of 25 years accidentally terminated during full-fibre switchover
grader.notes: Classic training case featuring two distinct customer outbursts: the agent handled the first with late empathy (3 turns after), but failed to acknowledge the second severe outburst when quoting a 5-day SLA, resulting in an Empathy FAIL rating.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net order provisioning and technical services' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Holds announced with bear with me and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Elisha throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent handled the first outburst with empathy at [02:30], but completely ignored customer's distress and crying at [08:15] regarding 5-day medical emergency exposure, reciting only cold SLA regulations.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent restated the digital voice porting omission and cease status accurately at [01:40].

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent confirmed mobile contact number accurately without repeating questions.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent submitted emergency recovery ticket and established network interception announcement.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained a supportive and constructive tone.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent asked effective diagnostic questions regarding dialed tone, ONT serial number, and phone cabling.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer dialed landline from neighbor phone and verified interception announcement broadcasted mobile number.
